correctness.rationale: The graph model is identified by explicit isomorphism with Fujita 2013 edge list. A matching recurrence generates exactly 36 perfect matchings. The 19-dimensional vertex-star subspace reduces 2^30 Walsh characters exactly to 2048 sign classes. Two distinct algorithms and independent graph labelings exhaustively compute the absolute multiplier histogram. Edge transitivity and 12 occurrences per edge prove divisisibility by four; the exact table attains four. Every unordered edge pair is checked, yielding exactly sixty first zeros. Exact integer Walsh inversion of nonzero support gives sum of kernel absolute numerators 21248 and norm 83/8. Translation averaging proves this optimal for all endpoint projections. Independent audit not performed.

value.rationale: The dodecahedral graph is a canonical smallest-fullerene skeleton, and its perfect-matching orbit is a natural dimer incidence codebook. Exact Fourier rank and sharp unrestricted range projection cost measure whether and how strongly the edge-incidence distribution permits Boolean convolution recovery. The first 60 sparse cancellation frequencies and six-value absolute spectrum are not the old unsigned matching count. A complete exact finite classification is useful as a reproducible benchmark, without claiming infinite-family impact.
